d:
The excitement surrounding the 2025 Bihar Assembly Elections has intensified. To gauge public sentiment, the Khabar Gaon team traveled to the Motihari Assembly constituency in East Champaran. People spoke about Nitish Kumar, Prashant Kishore, and Tejashwi Yadav. Crime and unemployment in Bihar were also discussed. But amidst all this, a boy's joking remarks reveal the connection between Bihar and crime.
Watch this ground report and understand public opinion about the Bihar elections.
